description: Delete one entry, or entries in a time range. From one list (collection) of an owned HTML page or site: up to 20 entries by `docIds` (moderation), or every entry created between `after` and `before`, either bound alone is enough (spam cleanup). Deleted entries cannot be restored. Returns the number deleted.

after.description: ISO 8601 time: entries created after it

before.description: ISO 8601 time: entries created before it

docIds.description: Entry ids from the listing, 1-20; instead of a time range

manageUrl.description: The page's private management link (https://brewpage.app/manage/...#k=...); stands in for namespace, id and ownerToken.

ownerToken.description: Owner token from create. Default: env BREWPAGE_OWNER_TOKEN (local server only).

name: delete_page_data
title: Delete page data entries
